commitResults.messageTitle: Add alpha-bug verification tests to ScreenshotTest
commitResults.messageBody:
5 new @Test methods verify issues #96-#100 via TestFX:
- #96: mark -1 ps/Paid produces clear "Invalid command format" error (not a bug)
- #97: find ps/Due and find n/Alice return 0 because FindCommandParser has no
  prefix support — plain name-keyword only (BUG CONFIRMED, broader than filed)
- #98: mismatched day/time error message includes exact counts (not a bug)
- #99: help command opens a second window correctly (not a bug)
- #100: DeleteCommand does not reset filtered list after delete (BUG CONFIRMED)

Also fixes find screenshot to use plain keyword (find John, not find n/John).
